description: Networked capture the case with simulants: listen host plus one client on loopback, Complex, three bots, 35 second time limit, same start path as mp_combat_net_bots_smoke. Baseline for the scenario state seam (T-NETWORKING-011): proves the objective scenario starts over the network, the host places its objective on a real pad (B-1125/B-1126 fill-in on extracted arenas) and both sides end with a match result for all five characters. Wire v62: the host sends each team's base (home and respawn pads) and each case's holder or place in the stage baseline and on every change, and the client takes those bases, highlights their rooms and shows the cases where the host has them. Written 2026-11-15; port 27245.

input_sequence.comment: Both processes share this schedule. The host arms --listen-bind and fires netStartServer on the first mainTick where g_NetInit is true (-> 'NET: created server on port 27200', the runner's barrier), seeds g_MatchConfig from --launch-mp-room, and arms --host-autostart. The client arms --connect-host and connects after the barrier. Once the client reaches CLSTATE_LOBBY on the host (slot 1) and a ~2s settle elapses, --host-autostart fires netLobbyRequestStartWithSims exactly once; the ready gate runs a 3s countdown (client answers manifest READY), then SVC_STAGE_START loads the arena on both sides. The match ends at the forced 35s time limit.

Scripted clean exit at 330s. Budget on the D: hard disk (first run 2026-11-14): the host reached --host-autostart at 194s because the client needed about 130s to boot and register the catalog, so a 200s exit cut the match 2.5s in. 330s covers that boot, the ~2s settle, the 3s countdown, the Felicity load on both sides, the 35s match and the end screen; timeout_seconds=390 backstops it. The client emits SMOKE: result=scripted_exit; the host may be reaped by the runner watchdog after an active loopback session, so the scripted-exit count is min:1 (client), not 2.

required_lines: NET: connected to server, sending CLC_AUTH
NET: client slot \d+ assigned to peer
MATCH: final scores published before stage end room=
CTC: team [0-3] case on base [0-3] pad=[0-9]+ room=[1-9][0-9]* respawnpads=[1-6] prop=ok
SCENARIO\.STATE: first state from host scenario=5 rev=[0-9]+
CTC: client bases from host rev=[0-9]+ team0 base=[0-3] room=[1-9][0-9]* holder=-?[0-9]+ team1 base=[0-3] room=[1-9][0-9]* holder=-?[0-9]+
forbidden_patterns: NET: could not init ENet, disabling networking
NET: could not create ENet host on port \d+
